name: HRAgent Integrations
description: Bundled, network-free MCP integrations catalog for the HRAgent marketplace. Each integration is a normal plugin directory (plugin.json + .mcp.json + README.md) that registers one or more external MCP servers.

integrations.name: github
integrations.description: GitHub — search code/repos, manage issues and pull requests via the official GitHub MCP server (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/, OAuth 2.0).

integrations.name: gmail
integrations.description: Gmail — read, search, send and manage email via official Google MCP server (https://gmailmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1, OAuth2).

integrations.name: google-drive
integrations.description: Google Drive — list, read, search and upload files via official Google MCP server (https://drivemcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1, OAuth2).

integrations.name: google-calendar
integrations.description: Google Calendar — events, scheduling and availability via official Google MCP server (https://calendarmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1, OAuth2).

integrations.name: google-chat
integrations.description: Google Chat — spaces, messages and threads via official Google MCP server (https://chatmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1, OAuth2).

integrations.name: google-people
integrations.description: Google People — contacts, profiles and domain directory via official Google MCP server (https://people.googleapis.com/mcp/v1, OAuth2).

integrations.name: microsoft-365
integrations.description: Microsoft 365 — Outlook mail/calendar, contacts, OneDrive and (org mode) Teams/SharePoint via ms-365-mcp-server (npx, MSAL OAuth).

integrations.name: slack
integrations.description: Slack — channels, messages and search via official Slack MCP server (https://mcp.slack.com/mcp, OAuth 2.1).

integrations.name: jira
integrations.description: Jira — teamwork graph context and objects via official Atlassian MCP server (https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2, OAuth/API token).

integrations.name: notion
integrations.description: Notion — pages, databases and blocks via the official Notion MCP server (https://mcp.notion.com/mcp, OAuth).

integrations.name: postgres
integrations.description: PostgreSQL — schema inspection and SQL queries via Postgres MCP Pro. Restricted (read-only, time-limited) mode by default.

integrations.name: linear
integrations.description: Linear — issues and projects via official Linear MCP server (https://mcp.linear.app/mcp, OAuth).

integrations.name: azure-ai-search
integrations.description: Azure AI Search integration — semantic, hybrid, and text search queries across your enterprise data via MCP.

integrations.name: cosmos-db
integrations.description: Azure Cosmos DB integration — query, schema discovery, and document exploration via the official Azure Cosmos DB team's MCP server sample.

integrations.name: document-editor
integrations.description: Office document editing — fill PDF AcroForm/XFA fields, overlay text on flat PDFs, read/validate/diff DOCX/XLSX/PPTX, without converting the document to a different format first.
